$comment: mirrobot-share plugin config. Priority: env vars > this file > code defaults. Keys: workerUrl, createToken, debounceMs (ms, default 10000), modelLabel ($Provider/$Model placeholders; literal text is sent as-is; empty string hides the model), ttlDays (per-share TTL, capped by the worker), openTasksInNewTab (task rows open subagent pages in a new tab), spoolDir (durability spool; default XDG data home).
